prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon preparation with carbohydrate loading for endurance event tomorrow

solution_criteria: Includes 4-5 distinct meals/snacks distributed throughout the day
All meals are practical, easily digestible, and suitable for pre-marathon fueling
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathoner) requiring maximum carbohydrate loading and specific calorie targets (4500+ calories)

prompt_inputs.goal: Maximize strength and muscle gain for weightlifting competition in 8 weeks

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all meals for one full day with specific times
Protein intake is adequate for strength/power athlete (minimum 1.6g per kg body weight)
Pre and post-training meals are strategically timed around a weightlifting session
Plan is compact and concise (fits within 1-2 brief paragraphs or bullet format)
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) emphasizing protein intake and meal timing around training sessions

prompt_inputs.goal: Build muscle and endurance for competitive soccer

solution_criteria: Meal plan is compact and covers exactly one full day (breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks)
All protein sources are vegetarian alternatives (legumes, tofu, tempeh, dairy, nuts, seeds)
Estimated daily calories and macronutrients are appropriate for a 72kg athlete with muscle-building goals
Meals are practical and concise without excessive detail
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with an athlete with dietary restrictions (vegetarian/vegan) requiring alternative protein sources while maintaining optimal sports nutrition
